coverage.notes: Mechanical abbreviation rules, controlled registry, List of Abbreviations checks, first-use checks, candidate review, and list generation are implemented.
Curated American-spelling review and nonpossessive eponym rules are implemented. Broad British-to-American replacement remains deferred because of MedDRA and formal-name exceptions.
Core clinical terminology, preferred wording, lean writing, inclusive language, participant terminology, dates, ages, and selected quantitative conventions are implemented.

Labels followed by numerals, clinical descriptors, generic document references, and selected eponyms are implemented. Heading title case is deferred because Word All Caps style formatting requires a separate formatting-aware approach.
Multiple punctuation spaces are currently production-suppressed. Forward slash, numeral apostrophe, email, dash mechanics, and known compound forms are implemented.
List introduction, single-item list, capitalization, and punctuation checks are implemented but remain Advanced-only pending further protocol calibration.

Dates, age expressions, selected prose ranges, p values, confidence intervals, operator spacing, percentages, and temperature spacing are implemented. Numeric ratio slash-versus-colon review is now implemented.
Trademark symbols, ampersands, selected symbol spacing, and mathematical notation are implemented. Nonbreaking spaces, rates, ratios, equations, and rounding remain Advanced or Manual Review.
Table headings, zero values, captions, footnotes, figures, and appendix numbering are implemented but remain Advanced-only because complex protocols require context calibration.
Scientific species, Latin expressions, chemical prefixes, and radiolabel formatting are implemented through Word formatting inspection.

Raw external URLs, active hyperlinks, trial aliases, and basic section-reference capitalization are implemented. Citation field protection and EndNote-aware validation are in progress. Citation placement before punctuation is now reviewed.
Appendix table and figure prefix/sequence checks are implemented. Broader appendix-document structure remains deferred.
Protected-term policy and registry synchronization are implemented.
Core preferred wording, terminology, trial naming, and lean-writing checks are implemented.
Comprise usage and selected terminology checks are implemented. Grammar-dependent entries remain Manual Review.
